reviews.review:
Highly recommend this game! 

This Game is a 12 out of 10! 

Let me start by saying I never played an Arma game until this one but I didn't need to play previous titles to get the full amazing experience Arma 3 delivers. Warning. This game taxes the CPU heavily. Fortunately I have the latest Skylake I-7 6700K @ 4.6ghz, Asus 1070 gpu also OC'd and 32 GB 3200mhz Ram OC'd as well, allowing me to run everything at Ultra with a DD of 4200 and OD of 2500 at a stable 60FPS (VSYNC ON). I could get up to 90-100 fps with Vsync Off but I love how smooth Vsync makes my game, its preference really. So yea, to get the most out of this game VISUALLY, you need a decent PC more on the CPU than the GPU. Honestly, its poorly optimized and that's why your CPU will run at 70-100% during gameplay. So if you max out settings and don't have proper cooling like my NH-D15 or a closed loop liquid setup, you will cook you CPU. Be careful. I actually got this game just to stress test my new PC. It's that demanding on your hardware. lol Though ended up blown away after getting into it.

Moving on..

If GTA:5 and Battlefield 4 made a baby, that baby would be Arma 3. Sprawling openworld rpg in its campaign/multiplayer. 

Amazing. Absolutely amazing game. There is so much to do! Lots of game modes, fan created maps for solo/co op and multiplayer, awesome campaign, show case levels for you to play and hone your skills with if your trying to master different vehicles like Attack Helicopters or the HUGE transport Helicopters, Jets, Tanks, Infantry, ect. You can create your own levels with a story, objective, loadouts or simply download other peoples levels to play on through workshop. They have game modes for online MP called ZUES and basically it's a D&D type of game where someone is a Game Master and creates scenarios on the fly for you as well as giving you different weapons, vehicles, spawn locations ect. Every Zues match I have played (alot already) has been completely different, keeping the online experience fresh each time. The online MP doesn't have a ton of people on constantly but it has enough to find and play games. A majority of the games I joined were non DLC, so you don't need APEX to enjoy this game but seriously, I recommend getting it as it offers a TON of goodies and offline/online maps/levels to play on. The DLC is worth every penny in my opinon.


The skills you learn in this game can be applied to real life. You'll need to learn how to read maps, use GPS, learn to counter and understand bullet drop, coordinate teamwork for complex operations at a large scale, use radio with proper replies/request, tactics for combat and so much more. Arma 3 is more than just a game, it's a great tool for those interested in the military or those who want the closest thing to the live thing. 


Get this game. Seriously. You won't regret it! I was going to buy Battlefield 1 but now I don't think I will, at least not day 1. I have everything I ever wanted in a Military shooter. This game is an all in one. If you like sprawling open world games, lots of weapons/vehicles, dynamic multiplayer and are a fan of anything military related. You will love this game wholeheartly. Top it off with a wonderful community. Everyone I have met is respectful and nice. I've only come across 1 or 2 kids, most of us are mature adults who just want to have fun. 

Thanks for reading! Take care.
